tools.name: list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: List every country available in the H-IUD budget impact model, with its currency, women of childbearing age, and HMB prevalence.

tools.name: get_country_inputs
tools.title: Get country model inputs
tools.description: Return the full model input set for one country: baseline market shares, per-patient costs (total, commodity, non-commodity), effectiveness, anemia rates, and DALYs per patient by treatment arm.

country.description: Country key or name, e.g. "KE" or "Kenya". Use list_countries to see options.

tools.name: run_budget_impact
tools.title: Run budget impact scenario
tools.description: Run the 5-year budget impact analysis for a country at a given H-IUD coverage target. Returns population, market shares before/after, total and per-patient costs, budget impact, DALYs averted, HMB cases resolved, anemia cases avoided, and a per-arm breakdown.

country.description: Country key or name, e.g. "KE" or "Kenya".

targetHIud.description: Target H-IUD market share after intervention, as a fraction 0-1 (e.g. 0.25).

hmbPrevalence.description: Override HMB prevalence as a fraction 0-1. Defaults to the country value.

deltaNs.description: Cannibalization weight for non-surgical patients (relative, default 0.15).

deltaSurgical.description: Cannibalization weight for surgical patients (relative, default 0.05).

deltaUntreated.description: Cannibalization weight for untreated patients (relative, default 0.8).

currency.description: Money unit: "LCU" local currency (default) or "USD" 2025 constant.

tools.name: compare_coverage_targets
tools.title: Compare H-IUD coverage targets
tools.description: Run the budget impact model across several H-IUD coverage targets for one country and return a compact comparison of budget impact, DALYs averted, and HMB cases resolved for each.

country.description: Country key or name, e.g. "KE" or "Kenya".

targets.description: H-IUD coverage targets as fractions 0-1, e.g. [0.1, 0.25, 0.5]. Max 10 values.
